Hey everyone...

Well it was my fault.

When I need to reinstall all the profiles I decided I wanted all the profiles to appear at the top of explorer separated from all the TB folders. (cache, storage, ect)

In other software needs I have always simply placed a _(underscore) before each folder name so they appear at the top separated from the app folders.

TB doesn't like it.

Reinstalling TB and Deleting all the parent.lock files did in fact solve the issue.
